title: Secure userSongProgress.ts and lineProgress.ts
description: Apply the same ctx.auth pattern to userSongProgress.ts and lineProgress.ts. Remove all visitorId arguments.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Import getAuthUserId, requireAuth from authHelpers in both files
userSongProgress: Remove visitorId from all args
userSongProgress: Use by_user index for all queries
lineProgress: Remove visitorId from all args
lineProgress: Use by_user index for all queries

notes:
Follow the EXACT same pattern as SEC-003 (wordProgress.ts):

1. Import helpers: `import { getAuthUserId, requireAuth } from './authHelpers'`
2. Remove visitorId from args: `args: {}` or only non-user args
3. Get userId inside handler: `const userId = await requireAuth(ctx)`
4. Query by userId: `.withIndex('by_user', q => q.eq('userId', userId))`

Check docs.local/convex-auth-patterns.md for reference if needed.
